_comment: I-316: donor smart_scripts rows whose castFlags (action_param2) are wrong in the
Neltharion 4.3.4 source itself. This is NOT an opcode-divergence remap — the
SmartCastFlags enum is byte-identical between the two cores (0x20 =
SMARTCAST_AURA_NOT_PRESENT in both). These rows simply ship a flag value that
contradicts what the source author wrote in the row comment, so a verbatim import
reproduces the donor's bug. Keyed by source_type:entryorguid:id; 'flags' is the
FINAL castFlags value written into the emitted row.
Only add a row here after checking the donor enum really does agree with AC's —
if the enums differ, the fix belongs in _spellscope as a remap, not here.

rows.why: Sister Goldskimmer (Kezan) — OOC_LOS re-cast of Power Word: Fortitude (74973) at any player within 8yd every 2s. Source comment says 'on Player Missing Buff' but castFlags was 2 (TRIGGERED) with no gate, so it re-buffs forever. 34 = TRIGGERED|AURA_NOT_PRESENT.
Sister Goldskimmer (Lost Isles) — identical donor row to 34692, same defect.
